artifact_review: The Router identified hand fusion (severity 2.5) and edge blur (severity 1.5). I agree with the hand fusion assessment; the fingers lack distinct joints and nails, merging into a smooth mass holding an indistinct object. The `animal_pose_auditor` flagged HIGH risk (47% low-confidence keypoints), particularly in the hind limbs (expected due to crop) but also in the ears and shoulders. The low confidence in the ears (keypoints 3 & 4) supports the visual observation of slight structural ambiguity in the head/fur transition. The `topology_boundary_auditor` mask shows significant noise/fringing on the right side, confirming the Router's note on edge bleeding. The `perceptual_quality_auditor` noted compression, which aligns with the overall softness. I am upgrading the severity of the hand artifact to 3.0 due to the complete lack of anatomical definition in the digits, which is a critical failure for a primate portrait.
